gpu_lines.common: Each line: precheck (module sha vs receipt; Build F2 working-tree engine source map vs its receipt; Build F vs 5c171477...), one FORGE_GPU_DRY_RUN=1 dry run (exit 78), then forge-gpu-run --min 30 --max <=1800 --label p1f2-<line> -- timeout <=1750s python3 -B scripts/apa_p1f2_gpu.py <mode> --out artifacts/apa_p1f2/gpu/<line>, from the worktree root. Exit 76: nothing ran, retry unchanged after >= 5 min, <= 6 times. Exit 124 = timeout, never a pass. Bitwise = np.array_equal on same-width unsigned views after dtype and shape checks; each bitwise pair checks both sides nonzero and non-constant (L19). A row = one (batch, head, query) output vector; non-finite if any element is. "No launch" = LD_PRELOAD counter of cudaLaunchKernel (F1 SHIM_SOURCE, imported), with a positive control. Timing fields (t, seconds) are excluded from every comparison.

LF2.label: p1f2-LF2

float32: public_default (storage=None, PackedSpKeys, pinned packed table, epsilon 0.01)
entries.sinks_entries: every entry above except eb2b (no sinks argument)

case_groups.qkv: REV1 make_inputs seed 11, B1 H8 KV2 S1024 D128 plant=False (F1 LF2 inputs), bf16 and fp32; one element set to NaN, +Inf or -Inf at F1 positions q (0,0,0,5),(0,5,0,77); k (0,0,100,5),(0,1,700,64); v (0,0,100,5),(0,1,700,64), plus one more position each: q (0,7,0,127), k (0,0,1023,127), v (0,1,0,0). 27 cases per dtype.
case_groups.sinks: same base inputs, sinks = bf16-rounded linspace(1,3,8) with head 2 set to NaN (sink_nan) or +Inf (sink_posinf); bf16 and fp32
case_groups.flt_max_r02: REV2 r02 exactly: fp32 B1 H1 KV1 S3 D128, q=k=ones, v=arange(384)/512, scale=FLT_MAX; entries d1_ordered, r2_tq4, r2_int4 (the public route refuses this scale in lookup before device work: recorded, not an entry)
case_groups.flt_max_g4: bf16 and fp32 B1 H8 KV2 S1024 D128: q heads 0-3 ones, heads 4-7 zeros, k ones, v = seed-11 v; scale=FLT_MAX; every raw entry of the dtype
case_groups.all_negative_logits: REV2 r01 construction on the raw entries: bf16 and fp32 B1 H8 KV2 S1024 D128, q zero except q[0,0:4,0,0] = +Inf (k all -1) or -Inf (k all +1), v = seed-11 v; every entry of the dtype incl. the fp32 public route
case_groups.r01_default_route: REV2 r01's twelve cases unchanged (D64, B1 H1 KV1 S3, q=ones, k=zeros, v=arange/256, scale .125, epsilon .5; k/q/v NaN, +Inf, -Inf, zero_keys, q +-Inf over all-negative logits), public default route vs both comparators

gates.G2a: NaN in q, k or v (qkv NaN cases, r01 k_nan/q_nan/v_nan): each entry non-finite row set == dense set (comparator a; and b for the public route)
gates.G2b: every case: entry non-finite set contains the dense set (a; and b for the public route)
gates.G2c: every case: no all-zero row in the entry where the dense row is non-finite
gates.G2d: rows non-finite in the entry and finite in dense are listed per case (allowed)

L19.rule: each case: comparator (a) has >= 1 non-finite and >= 1 finite row, unless declared here
declared_dense_all_finite: k +Inf at (0,0,100,5) (rule from inputs: every KV-group-0 head has q[...,5] < 0, so every dense score of that key is -Inf; matches F1 LF2 k_inf_rev1)
declared_single_row: flt_max_r02 (H1: one row; dense expected non-finite)
L19.prediction_record: dense non-finite heads predicted from the inputs by sign rule (not a gate): k +Inf (0,0,100,5) [] ; k -Inf (0,0,100,5) [0,1,2,3] ; k +Inf (0,1,700,64) [6] ; k -Inf (0,1,700,64) [4,5,7] ; k +Inf (0,0,1023,127) [0,1] ; k -Inf (0,0,1023,127) [2,3] ; q +-Inf at head h: [h] ; v +-Inf: the 4 heads of the KV group

LF2.expected: G2a-c hold in every case; F1 G2b misses (tq4 entries finite where dense is non-finite on +Inf k) are gone
